description: Quote a swap of USDC or USDT0 on Arbitrum into BTC over Lightning or to an Ark address (Satora): what you send, the sats you receive, and the fees (about 1% total (Satora ~0.5% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee; live rates are in the quote). Nothing is created

address.description: to=arkade: an Ark address from an Arkade wallet on https://arkade.computer (with amount). Lightning addresses are not supported

amount.description: to=arkade (or a Lightning quote without an invoice): token amount to send, like "1.5" (fees come out of it)

from.description: the stablecoin you send, on Arbitrum One

invoice.description: to=lightning: a BOLT11 invoice with an amount; Satora pays exactly it (required to create; no amount)

to.description: how the BTC is paid out (default lightning)

name: swap_to_btc_quote
